# Final required gate intake controls

The two ZIPs are exact public archives from the retained historical K runs. The
fixtures exercise original process, computed-value, reset, source and artifact
parsers. Causal corruptions are isolated test data. They do not execute Apple
code, refresh a native result, or satisfy final source acceptance.

RP49 uses its immutable repository/CI/packaging clause. An independent pinned
plan must precede activation, enumerate the required workflow event/ref/attempt,
retain all observed attempts, and select exact successful jobs and artifact
bytes. Docs requires both build and actual deploy; a successful Build on main at
the same final source is required. The intake reuses exact CI03 and CI04 source,
publication and signing checks without inheriting their record IDs.

BRG31's original computed-runtime clause remains incomplete. The retained
five-fixture PoC provides 17 computed diagnostic records and a fresh S01/F01
reset observation, but does not prove the full CI02/RP48 requirement of reset per
test and compile/import/run of all required safe fixtures with per-case
identities and saved originals. The module retains that bounded observation and
returns NOT_RUN for BRG31 until a dedicated complete native cohort is
implemented and validated. Adding names to a plan does not establish that
semantic proof.

The typed artifact contexts keep compiler, implementation and docs identities
separate. No END01 or final179 result is assumed or manufactured. Current tests
are validator controls only.
